statements.text: Impression: left-sided lumbar radiculopathy secondary to L4-L5 disc herniation causing foraminal stenosis.

CT lumbar spine 09/14/2026: L4-L5 disc herniation with moderate left foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.
Function: unable to stand long enough to cook a meal, has stopped driving because of the pain.

Reports radiating leg pain for about 3 months.
Has not yet started physical therapy or anti-inflammatory medication for this episode.
